speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms are quite concerning; have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or stool color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for clarifying; those are significant weight loss and systemic symptoms. Have you experienced any fever, or have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits besides the supraclavicular area? Also, have you had any blood in your stool or noticed any discoloration?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Tests (LFTs), Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR).
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound, Chest X-Ray.

text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that history; given your smoking history and the combination of B symptoms with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, we must rule out malignancy. Did you notice any night sweats severe enough to soak your bedding, and have you seen any skin lesions or changes in your gums recently? Please wait while I review the results of your CBC, LFTs, ESR, abdominal ultrasound, and chest X-ray.

REQUEST TEST: LDH, Beta-2 Microglobulin.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma
